item: The three layers against a cross-site POST are stated in SECURITY.md, FastAPI is floored at 0.132.0 and the JSON-route 422 is pinned (audit 0.5.0 item 35, options 1+2)
refs: coordinator 26 Oct 21:51: ship options 1+2 of the item 35 proposal; R252 proposal item 35 (open-items.md section 0.5.1 item 35); version-coupling rule
summary: docs/SECURITY.md now names the three layers (Host allow-set 421, Origin host+port 403, FastAPI strict_content_type 422) and what none covers (side-effect GETs, browsers sending no Origin/Referer; the six raw-body API modules have layer 2 only). pyproject floors fastapi at 0.132.0 (was >=0.110) with registry entry fastapi-strict-content-type (floor 0.132.0, verified 0.162.0 = newest on PyPI 2026-10-26; the lock pins 0.138.0) and tests/test_external_freshness.py ties the three places. tests/test_security_hardening.py pins that POST /api/newsletters/remove-imported answers 422 model_attributes_type to text/plain, text/plain;charset, form-urlencoded and no Content-Type, and still reaches the handler (400) as application/json. MEASURED on the unpacked wheels: 0.131.0 has no strict_content_type and fails ONE row (no Content-Type is parsed as JSON and reaches the handler); text/plain and form-urlencoded were already 422 there; 0.132.0, 0.138.0 and 0.162.0 pass all rows. Option 3 (Sec-Fetch-Site) and option 4 (own Content-Type middleware) not built.
